name: Normal Regularization
definition: A technique to alleviate numerical instability (jitter) of surface normals near the UDF zero-level set (cusps) by replacing naively sampled normals with interpolated normals from the neighborhood.
summary: Normal Regularization stabilizes UDF surface reconstruction by replacing unstable gradients with spatially interpolated normals from neighboring points, distinguishing itself by specifically targeting jitter at non-differentiable cusps.
